summary: Iteration 29 — End-to-end validation of the new Community Hub widget (Phase 2 missed item). Backend: 15/15 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_realm_hub_widget.py (create-permission, list+is_admin flag, validation matrix across thought/photo/video/sound/event/banana, author-vs-admin delete rules, multi-post newest-first ordering with hydrated author objects {id,username,name,avatar_url}, and wrong-widget-type 404 against a poll widget id). Frontend Playwright on /realms/dj (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL host): (a) founder stealth sees the new realm-widget-add-hub chip alongside poll/announcements/rules; clicking it POSTs /widgets and adds a fresh realm-hub-widget-<wid> tile with realm-hub-title 'Community Hub' + composer with all 5 kind chips (thought/photo/video/sound/event) + realm-hub-text + realm-hub-submit + realm-hub-feed; (b) all three client-side validations fire WITHOUT a network call — empty thought → 'Add a thought', photo without media → 'Please attach a photo', event with empty text → 'Event needs a title' — error visible in realm-hub-error; (c) switching kinds correctly toggles upload button (photo/video/sound) vs date input (event) vs neither (thought) and resets media/event state; (d) posting a thought of 'phase2-hub-test-thought' inserts a new realm-hub-post-<id> at the top of realm-hub-feed showing @stealth, the THOUGHT kind label and the text; (e) delete-own-post via realm-hub-post-delete-<id> removes the post; (f) delete-widget via realm-hub-delete-<wid> removes the entire tile after confirm dialog. Member view (tfone): realm-widgets-toolbar is hidden (admin-only — also matches the historical design), tfone can POST a thought via the hub composer and DELETE own post, and tfone does NOT see realm-hub-delete-<wid> (delete-widget chip). Regression: /friends and /messages still load without console errors after the hub flows. Pre-existing hub widget id 2df1b46fa5944c4f828cda43b9b399ef on /realms/dj reused for tests; clean post-cleanup performed.
critical_code_review_comments: realm_widgets.py (lines 348-442): _HUB_KINDS, HubPostCreate, GET/POST/DELETE /hub/posts and the wrong-widget-type 404 guard are clean and idempotent. _hub_author_brief returns the exact {id, username, name, avatar_url} keys the UI consumes; verified by GET hydration test.

CommunityHubWidget.jsx: client-side validation correctly short-circuits BEFORE the network call (verified: error messages appear with no POST in DevTools). Reset on kind-switch zeroes mediaUrl/eventAt/err — good. canDelete=isAdmin || p.author_id===user?.id matches the backend's author-or-admin policy.
RealmDetail.jsx render switch: w.type==='hub' branch renders <CommunityHubWidget/> with isAdmin + onDelete passed through. Toolbar chip realm-widget-add-hub is wired as the first item — matches spec.

Minor (non-blocking): the realm-widgets-toolbar is admin-only by design (only renders inside `{isAdmin && (...)}`), so members never see ANY add-widget chips. This matches the rest of Phase 2 (poll/announcements/rules) so I treated it as correct, not a regression.

Minor (non-blocking): CommunityHubWidget initialises kind state to 'thought' on mount but does NOT reset kind to 'thought' after a successful submit — composer stays on the previously chosen kind. Acceptable UX, just flagging for product review.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 14 acceptance items in the request validated)
